case_number: 2025 INSC 4; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) NO. 2184 OF 2024)
summary: Quashing of criminal proceedings under Section 482 CrPC; cognizance under Section 186 IPC requires prior written complaint by public servant per Section 195(1)(a) CrPC; absence of assault/criminal force allegations negates Section 353 IPC charge; High Court erred in relying on co-accused's case without addressing jurisdictional defects; quashing warranted where FIR fails to disclose cognizable offence.
legal_provisions_cited: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; criminal proceedings quashed for lack of jurisdictional compliance.
